description: Run the project's Playwright tests: stats plus each failure's file:line, kind and message. Diagnoses missing installs, dead dev servers, syntax errors, crashes and timeouts (kills the tree, keeps partial results). Reports progress; background: true returns a run id for long suites. Runs are recorded for analyze-history.

args.description: Extra Playwright flags from an allowlist, as --flag or --flag=value (e.g. --repeat-each=3, --shard=1/2, --trace=on)

background.description: Return a run id at once; poll get-run-status

browser.description: Playwright project name to run (matched against playwright.config projects)

config.description: playwright.config path or 1-based index when the project has several configs

grep.description: Only run tests whose title matches this regex

headed.description: Run with a visible browser window

lastFailed.description: Only re-run tests that failed in the previous run (Playwright --last-failed) — the fast fix → re-run loop

projectRoot.description: Project directory; defaults to the server working directory

retryOnFailure.description: Auto retry failing tests once before reporting failure (default true; ignored when retries is set)

testFiles.description: Test files/directories relative to the project root; "file:line" is supported. Omit to run the whole suite.

timeoutMs.description: Hard wall-clock limit for the whole run; the process tree is killed past it (default 120000)

name: run-test
title: Run E2E tests
